source_text: וְ/רָחַ֣צְתְּ וָ/סַ֗כְתְּ וְ/שַׂ֧מְתְּ שמלת/ך עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ ו/ירדתי הַ/גֹּ֑רֶן אַל תִּוָּדְעִ֣י לָ/אִ֔ישׁ עַ֥ד כַּלֹּת֖/וֹ לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת׀־׃
english_snapshot: Wash yourself[a], anoint yourself, and put your cloak on; then go down to the threshing floor[c][b]. Do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

signals.text: The Hebrew consonantal form is unusual here; in context it is commonly understood as Naomi's continued instruction to Ruth: 'go down to the threshing floor.'

source_text: וִ/יהִ֣י בְ/שָׁכְב֗/וֹ וְ/יָדַ֨עַתְּ֙ אֶת הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁכַּב שָׁ֔ם וּ/בָ֛את וְ/גִלִּ֥ית מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖י/ו ו/שכבתי וְ/הוּא֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔/ךְ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעַשִֽׂי/ן־־׃
english_snapshot: Then[a], when he lies down, note the place where he lies. Then go, uncover his feet, and lie down[b], and he will tell you what you should do.

signals.text: The written Hebrew form reads 'and I lay down,' but the context and traditional reading understand it as 'and you lie down.'

source_text: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הָ֠בִי הַ/מִּטְפַּ֧חַת אֲשֶׁר עָלַ֛יִ/ךְ וְ/אֶֽחֳזִי בָ֖/הּ וַ/תֹּ֣אחֶז בָּ֑/הּ וַ/יָּ֤מָד שֵׁשׁ שְׂעֹרִים֙ וַ/יָּ֣שֶׁת עָלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יָּבֹ֖א הָ/עִֽיר־־־׃
english_snapshot: Then he said[a], “Bring the cloak that is on you and hold it out.” So she held it out, and he measured six measures of barley and put it on her[b]. Then he went into the city.

signals.text: Some ancient versions and many translations read, 'Then she went into the city.' The Masoretic Text reads, 'Then he went into the city.'

source_text: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר בֹּ֔עַז בְּ/יוֹם קְנוֹתְ/ךָ֥ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה מִ/יַּ֣ד נָעֳמִ֑י וּ֠/מֵ/אֵת ר֣וּת הַ/מּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת הַ/מֵּת֙ קניתי לְ/הָקִ֥ים שֵׁם הַ/מֵּ֖ת עַל נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ־־־־׃
english_snapshot: Then Boaz said[a], “On the day you acquire the field from the hand of Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the wife of the dead man[c][b], in order to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”

signals.text: Hebrew text reads literally, 'I acquired' (or 'I have acquired') Ruth the Moabite; many understand the sense here as 'you also acquire' in context.
